## 21st (Remote)

21st's hosted MCP server provides access to its UI component catalog and AI-assisted component generation workflows. The Streamable HTTP endpoint is shared by the 21st CLI, website, and MCP clients. Authenticate with a 21st API key from the 21st API-key settings page sent in the `x-api-key` header. The legacy Magic MCP API keys were reset and are not compatible with this service.
